top_signals.title: Wheat Extends Drop as Trump Remarks Fuel Black Sea Truce Hopes
top_signals.summary: Wheat declined for a fourth day after US President Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an immediate “energy ceasefire,” raising hopes that an easing of hostilities could reduce Black Sea disruptions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Citi on Maneuvering Limited Government Fiscal Space
top_signals.summary: Stephanie von Friedeburg, Head of the Public Sector Group at Citi, discusses the issues that are top of mind for governments and central banks. She speaks with Avril Hong on the sidelines of the IMF and World Bank Annual Meetings in Singapore. (Source: Bloomberg)
